title: Customer
description: Customer record with personal information, company association, join date, lifetime value, and customer segment. Used for CRM systems, customer management, and business analytics.

city.description: City where the customer is located

country.description: Country where the customer is located

company.description: Company or organization the customer represents

joined_date.description: Date when the customer first registered or made their first purchase

lifetime_value.description: Total revenue generated from this customer over their lifetime

segment.description: Customer segment or category (e.g., premium, standard, enterprise)
